newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas has North Dakota oil discovery.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas has North Dakota oil discovery.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said Tuesday it had discovered a new Lodgepole Reef oil field an exploratory well in the city of Dickinson, N.D.

The company said logs of its Heart River No. 1 well, which was drilled directionally to a depth of 10,620 feet, indicated the well encountered 308 net feet of carbonate reef in the Lodgepole formation containing an oil column of about 140 feet.
Casing is being set and the well is expected to be production flow-tested within two weeks, TransTexas said.
TransTexas said it owns an 80 percent working interest in the well and the remining 20 percent is held by privately owned Phoenix Energy Cos Inc.

TransTexas said it is drilling a delineation well, the Dinsdale No. 2-4, which is now at a depth of 9,500 feet. This well is expected to reach total depth and an electric log survey be conducted by the end of the month.
A second delineation well is planned from the same surface location, which the company believes will better determine the size of the field and its reserves.
